Prepare subjects for repeated evaluation

Source: R/subjects.R
pmx_ode_subjects.Rd

Reads an event table once and keeps each subject's records ready for pmx_ode_subject_eval(), which an estimator calls at every parameter vector it tries. The same subjects serve the C API in inst/include/zupmxode.h.

Usage

pmx_ode_subjects(model, data, eta = NULL)

Arguments

model

A model from pmx_ode_model().

data

An event table, as for pmx_ode_solve().

eta

The names of the parameters that are etas. By default the model's parameters whose names start with eta that are not covariates.

Value

A list of class pmx_ode_subjects, one prepared subject per ID in the order they first appear, each a list with id, time (its observation times) and the subject itself. The attributes theta and eta name the parameters pmx_ode_subject_eval() expects. A prepared subject lives for the session: one saved and loaded again must be prepared again.

Details

The model's parameters split three ways. Those named in eta are the subject's random effects; columns of data named like a parameter are covariates; the rest are theta, in the order the model uses them. The split is stored on the result as the attributes theta and eta.

Errors

pmx_ode_error_argument for an eta that is not a parameter of the model or is a covariate; pmx_ode_error_events as for pmx_ode_solve().

See also

pmx_ode_subject_eval().

Examples

m <- pmx_ode_model({
  cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl); v <- exp(tv); ka <- exp(tka)
  cp <- linCmt()
})
ev <- pmx_ode_events(amt = 100, cmt = "depot", time = c(1, 4, 12, 24))
subs <- pmx_ode_subjects(m, ev)
attr(subs, "theta")
#> [1] "tcl" "tv"  "tka"
pmx_ode_subject_eval(m, subs[[1]], theta = c(tcl = 0, tv = 3, tka = -0.5),
                     eta = c(eta.cl = 0.1), sigma = list(cp = prop(0.1)))
#> $time
#> [1]  1  4 12 24
#> 
#> $pred
#> [1] 2.196872 3.909813 2.825413 1.461862
#> 
#> $var
#> [1] 0.04826248 0.15286634 0.07982960 0.02137041
#>
